name: AWS Neuron Trn1: bert-large-uncased fp32, trn1.2xlarge, batch 4, throughput-optimized
methodology: VENDOR MEASURED (AWS NeuronPerf, Neuron SDK 2.27.0). trn1.2xlarge = 1 Trainium chip. bert-large-uncased FP32 autocast Matmult-BF16, seq 128, batch 4, data-parallel, 'Batch' application. Latency P50 7.24 ms / P99 7.3 ms.
notes: Encoder throughput row — the strongest single-chip number AWS publishes for gen-1 Trainium and the direct comparison point to the Inf1 record for the same model class.
